unit.summary_zh: 用一般过去时讲已经发生的事：规则动词加 -ed，常用不规则动词单独记，否定和提问用 did。学完后，你能用 First / Then / After that / In the end 讲一段自己的经历。

can_do.en: Can use the past simple of regular and common irregular verbs in positive, negative and question forms.
can_do.zh: 能用一般过去时的肯定、否定和疑问形式，包括规则动词和常用不规则动词。

can_do.en: Can follow a short spoken account of a past event when it is told slowly and clearly.
can_do.zh: 对方说得慢而清楚时，能听懂一段讲过去事情的简短叙述。

can_do.en: Can tell a short story about a weekend or a trip in a few linked sentences.
can_do.zh: 能用几句连贯的话讲讲一个周末或一次出行。

grammar_points.pattern:
I visited my grandparents. (regular: + -ed)
We went to the seaside. (irregular: go → went)
I didn't go. / Did you go? — Yes, I did.
grammar_points.explanation_zh: 说过去某个时间发生并已经结束的事用一般过去时。规则动词加 -ed（visit → visited），常用不规则动词要单独记（go → went，see → saw）。所有人称形式都一样，没有“三单”变化。否定用 didn't + 动词原形，提问用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形，这两种情况下动词都回到原形。

examples.en: I stayed at home last weekend.
Did you wait for the next bus? — Yes, I did.
examples.zh: 你等下一班车了吗？——等了。

common_errors.why_zh: go 是不规则动词，过去式是 went。
Did 提问时，动词用原形。

vocabulary.example_en: What did you do last weekend?
I visited my aunt two days ago.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我两天前去看望了姑姑。

vocabulary.example_en: I stayed at home on Saturday.

vocabulary.zh: 拜访；参观（visit 的过去式）
vocabulary.example_zh: 我们参观了一家博物馆。

vocabulary.example_en: I saw Tom at the station.
We had breakfast in a café.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我们在一家咖啡馆吃了早饭。

vocabulary.zh: 遇见；见面（meet 的过去式）

vocabulary.example_en: We had lunch. Then we went home.
vocabulary.example_zh: 我们吃了午饭，然后回家了。
那之后，我的手机没电了。

vocabulary.example_en: In the end, I walked home.

objectives.en: Use regular verbs in the past simple (+ -ed).
objectives.zh: 能用规则动词的一般过去时（加 -ed）。

objectives.en: Use past time words: yesterday, last weekend, two days ago.
objectives.zh: 能用 yesterday、last weekend、two days ago 这类过去的时间词。

steps.body_zh: 周一上班，同事最常问的就是 How was your weekend?。回答时要说已经过去的事，英语用一般过去时。这节课先学最简单的一类：规则动词在后面加 -ed，比如 visit → visited，stay → stayed。

steps.instructions_zh: 先听。注意动词后面的 -ed。
steps.scene_zh: 周一早上，Lin 在办公室遇到同事 Sam。

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Hi Sam. How was your weekend?
lines.zh: 嗨，Sam。周末过得怎么样？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: It was great, thanks. I visited my grandparents in the country.
lines.zh: 很棒，谢谢。我去乡下看望了祖父母。

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: That sounds nice. What did you do there?
lines.zh: 听起来不错。你们在那儿做了什么？

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: We walked by the river and I cooked dinner for them. What about you?
lines.zh: 我们在河边散步，我还给他们做了晚饭。你呢？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: I stayed at home on Saturday. I cleaned my flat and watched a film.
lines.zh: 我周六待在家里，打扫了公寓，看了一部电影。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: And on Sunday?
lines.zh: 那周日呢？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: I played badminton with my sister. I'm a bit tired today!
lines.zh: 我和妹妹打了羽毛球。今天有点累！

steps.instructions_zh: 听一听，跟读。注意过去的时间词放在句末。

steps.question_zh: 这些动词说的是现在还是过去？它们有什么共同点？
steps.takeaway_zh: 说过去的事，规则动词加 -ed。I、she、we、they 都用同一个形式，没有“三单”变化。-ed 有三种读法：watched /t/，played /d/，visited /ɪd/。

steps.explanation_zh: Last Saturday 是过去，用过去式 cleaned。

steps.prompt_zh: 听录音，说话人什么时候去看望了姑姑？
steps.audio_en: I visited my aunt two days ago.
steps.explanation_zh: two days ago = 两天前。ago 放在时间段后面。

steps.instructions_zh: 用括号里的动词补全句子。
steps.explanation_zh: yesterday 表示过去，walk 加 -ed。

steps.instructions_zh: 把动词和它的过去式配对。注意拼写变化。

steps.prompt_zh: 回想对话：Lin 周六做了什么？
steps.explanation_zh: I stayed at home on Saturday. I cleaned my flat and watched a film. 打羽毛球是周日。

steps.instructions_zh: 补全句子。
steps.translation_zh: 我上周末去看望了祖父母。
steps.explanation_zh: last weekend 是过去，visit → visited。

steps.instructions_zh: 排成句子。
answers: I watched a film last night.
Last night I watched a film.
steps.explanation_zh: 主语 + 过去式 + 宾语 + 时间；时间也可以放在句首。

objectives.en: Use common irregular past forms: went, saw, had, took, bought, met.
objectives.zh: 能用常见不规则动词的过去式：went、saw、had、took、bought、met。

objectives.en: Say what you did on a day out in a few sentences.
objectives.zh: 能用几句话说说出去玩的一天做了什么。

steps.body_zh: 英语里最常用的一些动词偏偏不加 -ed，而是变成另一个词：go → went，see → saw。它们没有规律，但数量不多，而且天天都用。这节课学讲出游时最常用的六个。

steps.instructions_zh: 先听。找一找哪些过去式不是加 -ed 的。
steps.scene_zh: Lin 休了一天假，回来后朋友 Mia 问她去哪儿了。

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.en: You look happy! Did you have a good day off?
lines.zh: 你看起来很开心！休息日过得好吗？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Yes! I went to the seaside with two friends.
lines.zh: 很好！我和两个朋友去了海边。

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.en: Lovely. How did you get there?
lines.zh: 真好。你们怎么去的？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: We took the early train. Then we had breakfast in a little café by the beach.
lines.zh: 我们坐了早班火车，然后在海边一家小咖啡馆吃了早饭。

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.en: Did you swim?
lines.zh: 你们游泳了吗？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: No, the water was too cold. But we saw some dolphins! I took lots of photos.
lines.zh: 没有，水太冷了。不过我们看到了几只海豚！我拍了很多照片。

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.en: Wow. Did you buy anything?
lines.zh: 哇。你买东西了吗？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: I bought some postcards. And I met an old school friend at the station!
lines.zh: 我买了几张明信片。还在车站碰到了一个老同学！

steps.instructions_zh: 听一听，跟读。每个过去式都和原形一起记。

steps.explanation_zh: 不规则动词的过去式不加 -ed，要一个一个记。好消息是：和规则动词一样，所有人称都用同一个形式（I went，she went，they went）。be 动词有两个过去式：I / he / she / it 用 was，you / we / they 用 were。
steps.pattern: go → went, see → saw, have → had, take → took, buy → bought, meet → met

examples.en: My friends were at the station.

tips_zh: 记的时候把原形和过去式连起来读：go–went，see–saw，读几遍就有感觉了。
take 可以搭配很多词：take a train（坐火车）、take a photo（拍照）。

steps.instructions_zh: 把动词原形和过去式配对。

steps.explanation_zh: see 是不规则动词，过去式是 saw。

steps.instructions_zh: 用括号里的动词补全句子。
steps.explanation_zh: buy 的过去式是 bought，不是 buyed。

steps.prompt_zh: 听录音，他们在哪儿吃的早饭？
steps.audio_en: We took the early train and had breakfast by the beach.
steps.explanation_zh: had breakfast by the beach：在海边吃了早饭。

steps.prompt_zh: 回想对话：Lin 为什么没有游泳？
steps.explanation_zh: the water was too cold：水太冷了。

steps.task_zh: 说说你最近一次出去玩：去了哪里、怎么去的、看到了什么、买了什么。说 4–5 句，至少用 3 个不规则动词。
steps.prompt_en: Did you go anywhere nice recently?
model_answers: Yes, I went to Hangzhou last month. I took the fast train with my mum. We saw the West Lake and had lunch by the water. I bought some tea for my dad.
checklist_zh: 说了去哪里和什么时候（last month / two weeks ago）
至少 3 个不规则过去式（went、took、saw、had、bought、met）
没有把 go 说成 goed
句子之间用了 and 或 then 连起来

steps.instructions_zh: 用括号里的动词补全句子。
steps.explanation_zh: go 的过去式是 went。

options: I goed to work by bus.
I went to work by bus.
I go to work by bus yesterday.
steps.explanation_zh: 过去的事用过去式 went；有 yesterday 时不能用 go。

objectives.en: Make negatives and questions with didn't and did.
objectives.zh: 能用 didn't 和 did 构成否定句和疑问句。

objectives.en: Order a story with first, then, after that and in the end.
objectives.zh: 能用 first、then、after that、in the end 给故事排序。

steps.body_zh: 过去时的否定和提问有个省事的规律：都请 did 来帮忙，动词回到原形。I didn't go.，Did you see it?。另外学四个讲故事的顺序词，让你的经历听起来有头有尾。

steps.instructions_zh: 先听。注意 did 和 didn't 后面的动词。
steps.scene_zh: 朋友聚餐，Jack 迟到了快一个小时。

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Jack! What happened? Did you get lost?
lines.zh: Jack！怎么了？你迷路了吗？

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.en: No, I didn't. First, I missed the bus.
lines.zh: 没有。先是我错过了公交车。

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Oh no. Did you wait for the next one?
lines.zh: 哎呀。那你等下一班了吗？

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.en: Yes, I did. Then it didn't come for forty minutes.
lines.zh: 等了。结果它四十分钟都没来。

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Why didn't you call me?
lines.zh: 你为什么不给我打电话？

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.en: After that, my phone died. I didn't have my charger.
lines.zh: 那之后我手机没电了，我没带充电器。

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: So how did you get here?
lines.zh: 那你是怎么来的？

lines.speaker: Jack
lines.en: In the end, I walked. Did you start dinner without me?
lines.zh: 最后我走过来的。你们没等我就开吃了吗？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: No, we didn't. Come and sit down!
lines.zh: 没有。快来坐吧！

steps.instructions_zh: 听一听，跟读。顺序词后面常加逗号。

steps.question_zh: did 和 didn't 后面的动词是什么形式？

examples.en: Did you wait for the next one? — Yes, I did.
It didn't come for forty minutes.

examples.zh: 你为什么没给我打电话？

steps.takeaway_zh: 否定：didn't + 动词原形；提问：(疑问词 +) Did + 主语 + 动词原形。过去的意思已经由 did 表达了，所以动词不再加 -ed，也不用 went、saw。简略回答：Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

steps.prompt_en: ___ you see the match last night?
steps.explanation_zh: last night 是过去，普通动词 see 的问句用 Did。
didn't 后面用原形 go。

steps.instructions_zh: 排成问句。
steps.explanation_zh: Did + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他？

steps.instructions_zh: 补全简略回答。
steps.explanation_zh: Did you ...? 用 Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. 回答。

steps.prompt_zh: 听录音，选出最合适的回答。
steps.explanation_zh: Why 问原因，用 Because ... 回答。

steps.task_zh: 写 4 句话，讲一次不太顺利的出行（迟到、迷路、东西忘带了都可以）。分别用 First、Then、After that、In the end 开头，至少有一句否定句（didn't）。
model_answers: First, I got up late. Then I missed the train. After that, I didn't have time for lunch. In the end, I arrived at the meeting ten minutes late.
checklist_zh: 四句分别用 First / Then / After that / In the end 开头
至少一句 didn't + 动词原形

steps.instructions_zh: 用括号里的提示补全句子。
steps.explanation_zh: 否定：didn't + 动词原形 come。

steps.prompt_zh: 回想对话：Jack 最后是怎么来的？
steps.explanation_zh: In the end, I walked.：最后我走过来的。

lessons.title_en: Unit Review: A Story to Tell

objectives.en: Understand a friend's story about a past trip.
objectives.zh: 能听懂朋友讲的一次过去的旅行。

objectives.en: Tell and write your own story with past forms and sequence words.
objectives.zh: 能用过去式和顺序词讲出、写出自己的经历。

steps.body_zh: 先听 Lin 讲她的西安之行，回答几个问题；再复习规则和不规则过去式；最后轮到你讲、写一段自己的经历。

steps.instructions_zh: 听两遍。第一遍只听大意，第二遍注意细节。
steps.scene_zh: 假期结束，Sam 问 Lin 去了哪里。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Where did you go for the holiday?
lines.zh: 你假期去哪儿了？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: I went to Xi'an with my parents. We stayed there for five days.
lines.zh: 我和爸妈去了西安，在那儿待了五天。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Did you see the Terracotta Warriors?
lines.zh: 你们看兵马俑了吗？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Yes, we did! We took a bus there on the second day. It was amazing.
lines.zh: 看了！第二天我们坐公交去的，太震撼了。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: What did you eat?
lines.zh: 你们吃了什么？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: We had noodles every day. My dad loved them.
lines.zh: 我们天天吃面，我爸特别喜欢。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Did anything go wrong?
lines.zh: 有没有出什么状况？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: Well, on the last day we missed our train. In the end, we got the next one.
lines.zh: 嗯，最后一天我们错过了火车，最后坐了下一班。

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.en: Did you buy any presents?
lines.zh: 你买礼物了吗？

lines.speaker: Lin
lines.en: I bought you this! It's a small warrior.
lines.zh: 给你买了这个！一个小兵马俑。

steps.prompt_zh: Lin 一家在西安待了几天？
steps.explanation_zh: We stayed there for five days.：待了五天。
on the last day we missed our train：最后一天错过了火车。

steps.prompt_zh: Lin 给 Sam 带了什么？
steps.explanation_zh: It's a small warrior.：一个小兵马俑。

steps.instructions_zh: 把动词和过去式配对，规则和不规则的都有。
排成问句。
steps.explanation_zh: Did + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他？

steps.task_zh: 讲一次你记得的旅行或假期，说 5–6 句：去了哪里、和谁、做了什么、出了什么状况、最后怎么样。用上 First / Then / After that / In the end。
steps.prompt_en: Tell me about a trip you remember.
model_answers: Two years ago I went to Qingdao with my friends. First, we took the train and stayed in a small hotel near the sea. Then we swam and had seafood every night. After that, it rained for two days, so we visited a museum. In the end, it was a really fun trip.
checklist_zh: 说了时间（two years ago / last summer）
用了至少 3 个顺序词
规则和不规则过去式都有
有一个小状况或转折，故事有结尾

steps.task_zh: 给朋友发一条消息（3–4 句）：说说你上周末做了什么，最后问对方一个 Did you ...? 问题。
model_answers: Hi Mia! Last weekend I visited my aunt in Suzhou. We walked in a beautiful garden and I bought some silk for my mum. Did you go to the concert on Saturday?
checklist_zh: 至少两句用过去式讲周末
最后一句是 Did you + 动词原形 ...?
问句里的动词没有用过去式

steps.instructions_zh: 用括号里的提示补全句子。
steps.sentence_en: We ___ (not / have) time to visit the museum.
steps.translation_zh: 我们没时间去博物馆了。
steps.explanation_zh: 否定：didn't + 原形 have。
last summer 是过去，Where + did + 主语 + 动词原形？
